main_text.head: ELENCHVS LIBELLO-rum,quos in hac editione coniunximus.
main_text.p: Impietas Valentini Gentilis breui scripto detecta, & palam traducta per D.Iohannem Caluinum.
Prothefeon eiusdem Gentilis refutatio breuis, sed firma & solida, eodem auctore.
Eiusdem responsio nunquam antehac edita, ad quasdam quæstiones à Georgio Blandrata, altero in filium Dei blasphemo, propositas.
Eiusdem duplex ad Polonos fratres admonitio.
D.Iosiæ Simleri, Tigurinæ Ecclesiæ doctoris Theologi, eruditissima ad Polonos de iisdem controuersiis epistola.
D. Andreæ Hyperii, Marpurgensis Ecclesiæ Doctoris Theologi, theses eiusdem argumenti.
Arianorum nuper in Polonia exortorum refutatio per Iohannem VVigandum D.
Assertio doctrinæ Ecclesiæ Catholicæ de sancta Trinitate, cum confutatione erroris Valentini Gentilis, per D.Alexandrum Alesium, Lipsiensis Ecclesiæ doctorem.
Geneuensis Ecclesiæ Ministrorum epistola eiusdem argumenti.
Theodori Bezæ theses de Deo, essentia vno, personis trino.

page.notes: Excluded as not printed on this page: the mirrored show-through of the title ("Valentini Gentilis ... ") in the upper right, the faint show-through imprint lines near the foot, the library stamp and its shelf mark in red and black, and the handwritten marks near the stamp. The title line "ELENCHVS LIBELLO-rum,quos" has no space after the comma as printed. The word "Prothefeon" is transcribed as printed; I could not confirm its Greek source with certainty.
